technical.summary: Short-term momentum is bullish with rising RSI and MACD crossover, but intermediate/long-term structure is weak (below 200-SMA, outside Ichimoku cloud, low ADX), making this a moderate-risk swing entry suitable only for tactical traders with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 35 days create a low-conviction environment with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling by junior member in fear-dominated market with no news confirmation; insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (333), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational revenues, FOMC event just passed, and earnings binary 35 days out create hostile trading environment for discretionary consumer stock.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI rising, MACD bullish crossover, Supertrend bullish) offers tactical entry near support (287.56) with defined risk in fear-dominated market creating contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising USD), price below 200-SMA and outside Ichimoku cloud, weak ADX trend strength, high earnings risk in 35 days, and zero fundamental/insider conviction make this a low-probability swing with asymmetric downside in hostile environment.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI rising, MACD bullish crossover) offers tactical entry at support, but macro environment is severely hostile with VIX in crisis, flat yield curve signalling recession, and rising USD headwinds.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 35 days combined with macro deterioration (VIX 333, yield curve inversion, strong USD) creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs short-term momentum setup.
